name: Restoring engineering execution resources
from: An engineering authority, execution or receiving resource prevents otherwise authored qualified engineering services from completing their work.
to: An independently examined immutable source proposal restores the specified engineering resource boundary with actual canonical duty, selected-method, capability, session, model and independent receiving checks preserved. This receives the source action only; exact integration, necessary publication and operating consumer receipt remain separate obligations under the parent engineering delivery.
cost: Bounded engineering leadership attention and compute to remove a shared execution obstruction.
otherwise: Workers remain unable to use their actual authored services, or source-only results are mistaken for operating delivery.
